WHY THIS TEST. Raymond Tolliver, a living borrower in assisted living, is selling his vacant duplex below the balance (690000.00 against a statement balance of 764632.62 and an appraisal of 740000.00) while the loan is referred to foreclosure. The plan used is Approved Short Sale Payoff, open to the borrower by its entry gate; the Estate Market Sale plan (estates) is no longer used (closes the round-1 plan-situation note). He asks only to wire what he must put in so the sale closes; the scored root is his own wire (owner=user). The agent must discover daily accrual -> statement -> short-sale approval -> contribution, each a multi-factor computation, and hand over the wire.

SCOPE. Claimed (task 1): payoff_ext_sale_daily_accrual / record_sale_daily_accrual_1c6aaad4; payoff_ext_sale_statement_balance / issue_sale_payoff_statement_764045f1; payoff_ext_sale_cost_allowance / approve_sale_closing_costs_11c6cfd9 (now sets contract price, allowed costs, required payoff and appraisal basis: SP-4 closed); payoff_ext_sale_seller_shortfall / remit_seller_closing_shortfall_d501bd8d (owner=user). Scope: an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record. Task 0 holds the retention chain; scopes are disjoint by plan.

 No relocation allowance (SP-2 closed). The acceptance sentence is retired only for the seller's own contribution on a borrower short sale, with the in-force wording restated (SP-3 closed). Wire-only plan: every receipt is a wire (SF-6 closed). LESA bills are paid by a Fully Funded LESA whose balance runs short; the shortfall is the seller's (setaside shortfall rule), not projected twice (SF-4 closed). Postings on the 1st through 2026-10-01; inspection fees posted the day ordered (SF-2/SF-3 closed).
 Near-misses: the recalled 1000.00 wire still counts as a wire receipt but not as held funds; the February case's wire and return are excluded by payoff_case_id; paid bills excluded by status; the 2025 appraisal is not on the case (only the 2026-07-14 update).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. authorized_request_on_file: request fc080b19 received 2026-10-06 (statement within 7 business days); the statement recipient overwrite admits the borrower on his own short sale. appraisal_current: 2026-07-14, within 6 months. contract_on_file: contract 6296dd89 received 2026-10-08, reviewed within 10 business days; arm's length; price 690000.00 >= 88% x 740000.00 and below the Estate Market Sale minimum 703000.00; listed 2026-03-20, at least 30 days before.

Skip X -> statement 759028.34; skip B -> contribution 771.85; skip A -> approval may not be made; root on the opening world 135.00.

PERSONA. Dry-humoured retired machinist; volunteers the sale below the balance, the foreclosure letter and the wish to wire his own share today; identity on request; Marcus's and his own recalled wire, the buyer and the vacancy only when asked; generic consent; one re-check; wire on hand-over; ends on receipt. It no longer says Cedarline 'has to sign off on the sale' (round-1 SOURCE-CHAIN closed).

WRITES. 1 record_sale_daily_accrual_1c6aaad4 127.37; 2 issue_sale_payoff_statement_764045f1 good-through 2026-11-14, balance 764632.62; 3 approve_sale_closing_costs_11c6cfd9 contract 690000.00, allowed 59950.00, required 621183.34, basis 740000.00; 4 (user) remit_seller_closing_shortfall_d501bd8d wire 'Raymond Tolliver' 2721.85.

REWORK ROUND 3. R2-N1: the contribution cushion (636.85) is per diem collected in advance and refunded to the extent unused; Raymond's wire is credited 2026-10-15, before the 2026-11-14 good-through date, so it is refunded in full after satisfaction; only the wire fee, returned-item fee and title search fee are retained. Scored amount 2721.85 unchanged. R2-O1: the short-sale per-diem maintenance carry now reads the latest inspection result (vacant), the same condition as the statement's preservation charge. Tie rules: the approval needs exactly one received contract; the contribution reads the latest accepted contract, the largest commission and other costs among accepted contracts sharing that request_date; bills and inspection results as in task 0. R2-O2: no closing_date counts 0 months. Probes: a second received contract -> required 0.00 (no approval figures); a same-day second accepted contract with commission 42000.00 -> contribution 3321.85; latest inspection occupied_by_others -> per diem 127.19; no closing_date -> contribution 2666.85.
user_scenario:
You are Raymond Tolliver, 85, a retired Boeing machinist with a dry sense of humor who now lives in an assisted-living apartment in Seattle. Your duplex in south Seattle carries a Cedarline reverse mortgage; it has stood empty since you went into assisted living, and a letter told you the loan has been sent to a foreclosure attorney. A young couple has signed a contract to buy the duplex for less than you owe, and your real estate agent told you that you will probably have to put in some money of your own so the sale can close. You call because you want to send whatever you personally have to bring for this sale today, by wire from your own bank account in your own name, so nothing holds the sale up. You do not know the amount and expect them to work it out and tell you.

You give your name, Raymond Tolliver, right away. To confirm who you are you give your phone number 4155550262 and the last four of your Social Security number, 5741. You do not know the loan number and ask them to look it up.

If they ask about money already sent: your son Marcus wired some last week, and you wired some yourself the same day, but your bank pulled your wire back by mistake; you do not remember the amounts. If they ask about the buyer, you say it is a young couple you had never met before. If they ask whether anyone lives in the duplex, you say both units have been empty since you went into assisted living. If they explain that something has to be prepared, figured or approved on Cedarline's side first, you tell them to go ahead and do it now. If the amount they give you seems odd, you say once that it is not what you expected and ask them to double-check it, then accept the figure they confirm.

When they tell you the amount and hand you the way to send it, you send it yourself as a wire, with the sender name exactly 'Raymond Tolliver' and exactly the amount they gave. When they tell you the money has been received, you thank them and end the call.

edges.policy_source: The seller closing contribution is not worked out until the payoff case carries an approved short-sale allowance for its closing costs.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain R -> B -> A -> X: the contribution reads the allowance the approval sets, the approval may be made only once the statement balance is on the case, and the statement reads the recorded per diem; no two writes may be swapped.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the approval leaves allowed_closing_costs 0.00 and the contract unaccepted; the contribution becomes 771.85 instead of 2721.85.

Skipping the statement leaves statement_balance 0.00, so the Estate Market Sale minimum (the lesser of the statement balance and 95% of the appraisal) cannot be tested and the short-sale approval may not be made; the approval's figures are not changed by the statement, the gate is.
Skipping the daily accrual leaves per_diem_amount 0.00, so the statement balance is 759028.34 instead of 764632.62.
